python3 -c "
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

# Traj-level 4 seeds
traj_acc = [85.66, 85.47, 87.40, 87.31]
traj_uf1 = [87.50, 87.00, 88.70, 88.27]
traj_rf1 = [83.18, 83.52, 85.80, 86.17]
traj_con = [79.94, 78.59, 78.80, 76.74]

print('=== 4-seed traj-level summary ===')
for name, vals in [('accuracy', traj_acc), ('unresolved_f1', traj_uf1), ('resolved_f1', traj_rf1), ('consistency', traj_con)]:
    print(f'{name}: {np.mean(vals):.2f} ± {np.std(vals, ddof=1):.2f}')

# Per-test 3-seed: mean=88.41, std=0.96
# We don't have individual values, use Welch's t-test from summary stats
traj_mean = np.mean(traj_acc)
traj_std = np.std(traj_acc, ddof=1)
traj_n = 4
pt_mean = 88.41
pt_std = 0.96
pt_n = 3

# Welch's t-test
se = np.sqrt(traj_std**2/traj_n + pt_std**2/pt_n)
t_stat = (traj_mean - pt_mean) / se
# Welch-Satterthwaite df
num = (traj_std**2/traj_n + pt_std**2/pt_n)**2
den = (traj_std**2/traj_n)**2/(traj_n-1) + (pt_std**2/pt_n)**2/(pt_n-1)
df = num / den
p_val = 2 * stats.t.sf(abs(t_stat), df)

print(f'\n=== t-test: traj-level vs per-test accuracy ===')
print(f'Traj-level: {traj_mean:.2f} ± {traj_std:.2f} (n={traj_n})')
print(f'Per-test:   {pt_mean:.2f} ± {pt_std:.2f} (n={pt_n})')
print(f't = {t_stat:.3f}, df = {df:.2f}, p = {p_val:.4f}')
print(f'Significant at 0.05? {\"YES\" if p_val < 0.05 else \"NO\"}')
print(f'Difference: {traj_mean - pt_mean:.2f} pp')
"
